subject.title: fix(cron): expose flat cron job fields and normalize malformed tool args

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support this expanded flat cron add/update interface for models, including provider overrides and scheduling controls, alongside the existing nested job/patch contract?
rationale: The prior review reports no narrow mechanical defect but identifies the model-facing surface and prompt expansion as an ownership decision; the required current-source confirmation was unavailable in this review environment.

options.title: Accept the flat contract
options.body: Approve the flat fields as supported model-facing behavior after a final rebase and current-main authorization review.

options.title: Narrow the interface
options.body: Retain only an explicitly supported subset of flat fields and leave advanced controls nested.

options.title: Decline the new surface
options.body: Keep the nested job/patch interface only if the prompt and policy expansion is not desired.

recommendation.title: Accept the flat contract
recommendation.body: Approve the flat fields as supported model-facing behavior after a final rebase and current-main authorization review.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged related cron compatibility work provides the strongest available historical connection to this contract decision.
